2.289 Custom
Applies to RDL 2003/10
The Custom element specifies properties for which report design tools can pass information to custom
report renderers and custom report items. The contents of the Custom element MUST be valid XML
[XML10/5].
Following are the parent elements of the Custom element.
Parent elements
Report
Image
Line
Rectangle
Subreport
Textbox
List
Matrix
Table
Grouping
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Custom element.
 <xsd:complexType name="CustomType">
   <xsd:sequence>
    <xsd:any processContents="skip" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
   </xsd:sequence>
 </xsd:complexType>
